title: Schwarz Genus of the Flex-Point Cover
stopped_early_reason: A complete upper-bound construction was obtained, matching the cited lower bound.
literature_search_limitation: Bounded searches; absence of an earlier resolution and novelty are not certified.
scope: One continuously selected flex over each section domain for the coefficient space CP^9 minus the cubic discriminant; not simultaneous labeling of all nine flexes and not the PGL3 moduli quotient.
primary_source_wording_caveat: The OWR report uses trivial-cover wording with connected domains; this is stronger if read literally. The 8-versus-9 problem in Chen-Wan explicitly uses ordinary section-based Schwarz genus.
proof_dependencies: Classical Hesse parameterization and Hessian semidirect-product action
Equivariant tubular neighborhoods for compact smooth group actions
Covering homotopy lifting and the covering-dimension refinement theorem
new_upper_bound_mechanism: Repeated projective eigenvalues imply a fixed flex; cyclic circle stabilizers consequently have a common fixed sheet. Section neighborhoods of the circle orbits descend to an orbit space of dimension at most seven and admit an eight-color refinement.
verification_limitations: No independent audit completed at author freeze
